links.comparator_used: Original prompts before updating to emphasize ICD-10 laterality (after error analysis)
links.outcome: ICD-10 coding accuracy, where laterality was the most common error
links.effect: Prompts updated to emphasize ICD-10 laterality demonstrated improved accuracy (40%), compared with 23.9% correct ICD-10 codes overall
links.tradeoff: Accuracy remained low even after the update; the authors conclude public-facing LLMs are not ready for independent use
